specification.event: q crossing including reversal; >=3 of next5 q retain direction; failed crossings negative
specification.target: first confirmed onset within next1..7 days, different from current q
specification.legacy: unchanged neutral>=10d and >=8/10 confirmation; four-year extension starts2021
specification.purge: fixed target information window12d(new)/17d(legacy), plus1d embargo
specification.folds: expanding fit, separate preceding3mo stopping +3mo calibration/policy, six-month tests
specification.capacity: XGB hist CPU depth2 child10 eta.05 L2=10 L1=.1 gamma.1 bins64 subsample.8 columns.8; <=256 rounds,20 earlystop
specification.imbalance: capped sqrt train-only class weights; inverse event multiplicity; sigmoid calibration, >=5 per class else identity

policies.precision80: max calibration recall with precision>=.8 and>=5alarms; otherwise disabled

specification.matching: strict signed lead1..7d, 7d alarm cooldown across folds; one-to-one
specification.coverage: emitted alarms / eligible mature forecast origins; recall covers every scoreable confirmed event
specification.CI: 1000 circular calendar-block draws at28/56/84d; widest95% envelope
specification.trial_status: definition chosen after previous DEV findings; historical exploratory, never fresh holdout
specification.success_gate: precision CI lower>=.8, recall CI lower>=.3, >=50alarms,>=30events,>=12 28d event clusters, positive paired Brier gain CI in>=3years; otherwise NO_EDGE

funding_source_verification.method: Binance monthly archives; local ZIP cache SHA-256 checked
